settings.heading: If You Can
settings.heading_accent: Sketch It, We Can Build It.
settings.text: Nursery signs, toys, collectibles, party props — send us your idea and we'll figure out how to make it in 3D print, laser cut, resin, or a mix of all three.

settings.title: You tell us
settings.text: Send a sketch, reference photo, or just describe the idea.

settings.title: We quote it
settings.text: A price and timeline back within 2–3 days, no payment needed yet.

settings.title: We make it
settings.text: Designed, printed or cut, then sanded and finished by hand.

settings.title: It's yours
settings.text: Shipped, or ready for pickup, exactly as discussed.

settings.heading: Have Something Weird in Mind?
settings.text: Send your sketch, reference or theme and we'll figure out how to make it. Most custom pieces get a quote back within 2–3 days.
settings.success_text: Got it! We'll come back with a quote within 2–3 days.
settings.disclaimer: No payment is taken here — we'll send a quote first.

settings.question: How long does a custom piece take?
settings.answer: Most pieces are 1–2 weeks from approved quote to done, depending on size and finish. Rush timelines are sometimes possible — ask when you send your idea.

settings.question: How much does a custom piece cost?
settings.answer: It depends entirely on size, material and finish — a small painted name sign is a different job to an oversized event prop. We always quote before any payment is taken.

settings.question: Can I see a proof before it's made?
settings.answer: Yes — for anything with text or a specific layout, we send a digital proof to approve before production starts.

settings.question: Do you ship custom orders?
settings.answer: Yes, worldwide. Larger or fragile pieces may ship in multiple parts with assembly instructions.
